title: Bulk Loading with COPY & \copy
description: Import and export millions of rows per second using binary/CSV streams with COPY and client-side \copy.

data.text: When loading millions of rows, executing individual `INSERT` statements (even in batches) has severe query parsing and transaction overhead. The **`COPY`** command streams raw data directly into the database engine, bypassing query planning and achieving ingestion rates exceeding 100,000+ rows per second.

data.title: Streaming CSV Bulk Load with Options
data.content: Configuring header skip, delimiter, and NULL string representations.
data.code:
-- High-performance client-side CSV load
\copy measurements (sensor_id, temperature, recorded_at) 
FROM 'readings_2024.csv' 
WITH (
    FORMAT csv, 
    HEADER true, 
    DELIMITER ',', 
    NULL 'NA'
);

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: `COPY` is the fastest method for bulk inserting data into PostgreSQL.
Use `\copy` in `psql` to load files directly from your local development machine.
Temporarily dropping indexes and foreign keys before bulk loading can increase ingestion speed by 5x to 10x.
